Congratulations to Mario Juan Gordillo-Pérez and co-authors on their new publication in *Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution*!

* **Full Title:** *Genome-wide identification and evolutionary characterization of predicted HSP70 proteins in the Cuban painted snail Polymita picta*
* **DOI:** [10.3389/fevo.2026.1933916](https://doi.org/10.3389/fevo.2026.1933916)
